description: Backend manifest for forge-integration — maps all relevant smart contracts and NestJS API endpoints for the forge prototype

smartContracts.name: LendingPool
smartContracts.description: Core lending engine. All user balances are euint128 — encrypted 128-bit integers. Supports supply (shield), borrow (with LTV check or oracle), repay, liquidate, and withdraw.

writeFunctions.name: shield
writeFunctions.description: Supply tokens with encrypted amount. FHE.eq verification on plain vs encrypted.

writeFunctions.name: borrowWithLtvCheck
writeFunctions.description: Borrow with encrypted LTV check computed entirely on ciphertext.

writeFunctions.name: borrowWithOracle
writeFunctions.description: Oracle-based borrow with Pyth price health check.

writeFunctions.name: repayDebt
writeFunctions.description: Repay encrypted debt amount.

writeFunctions.name: partialUnshield
writeFunctions.description: Partial withdrawal of supplied tokens.

writeFunctions.name: unshieldWithProof
writeFunctions.description: Withdraw using threshold network proof (verifyDecryptResult).

writeFunctions.name: requestBalanceReveal
writeFunctions.description: Reveal supply balance publicly via FHE.allowPublic. 1-hour cooldown.

writeFunctions.name: requestBorrowReveal
writeFunctions.description: Reveal borrow balance publicly via FHE.allowPublic. 1-hour cooldown.

writeFunctions.name: requestUnshield
writeFunctions.description: Request full unshield by making supply balance publicly decryptable.

writeFunctions.name: withdrawPausedWithProof
writeFunctions.description: Emergency withdrawal when contract is paused, using proof.

writeFunctions.name: liquidateWithProof
writeFunctions.description: Liquidate an undercollateralized position with oracle price + FHE proof.

writeFunctions.name: requestLiquidityCheck
writeFunctions.description: Reveal both borrow and supply balances for a user for liquidation check.

writeFunctions.name: shieldEth
writeFunctions.description: Supply ETH (auto-wraps to WETH) with encrypted amount.

writeFunctions.name: partialUnshieldEth
writeFunctions.description: Withdraw WETH and unwrap to ETH.

writeFunctions.name: depositFor
writeFunctions.description: Composer-only. Deposit on behalf of a user with pre-verified handle.

writeFunctions.name: borrowFor
writeFunctions.description: Composer-only. Borrow on behalf of a user with pre-verified handle.

writeFunctions.name: repayFor
writeFunctions.description: Composer-only. Repay on behalf of a user with pre-verified handle.

writeFunctions.name: flashLoan
writeFunctions.description: Execute a flash loan (ERC3156).

writeFunctions.name: setOracle
writeFunctions.description: Owner-only. Set the price oracle address.

writeFunctions.name: disableOracle
writeFunctions.description: Owner-only. Disable the price oracle.

writeFunctions.name: setWeth
writeFunctions.description: Owner-only. Set the WETH address.

writeFunctions.name: disableWeth
writeFunctions.description: Owner-only. Disable WETH.

writeFunctions.name: setComposer
writeFunctions.description: Owner-only. Set the Composer address.

writeFunctions.name: transferOwnership
writeFunctions.description: Start ownership transfer to new address.

writeFunctions.name: acceptOwnership
writeFunctions.description: Accept ownership transfer.

writeFunctions.name: pause
writeFunctions.description: Owner-only. Pause the contract.

writeFunctions.name: unpause
writeFunctions.description: Owner-only. Unpause the contract.

events.name: Borrowed
events.signature: Borrowed(address indexed, address indexed, address indexed)

events.name: PausedWithdrawn
events.signature: PausedWithdrawn(address indexed, address indexed, uint256 indexed)

events.name: Liquidated
events.signature: Liquidated(address indexed, address indexed, address indexed, address, uint256, uint256)

events.name: FlashLoan
events.signature: FlashLoan(address indexed, address indexed, uint256 indexed, uint256)

fheMarkers.note: Balances stored as euint128. Equality verification via _verifyEquality (FHE.eq → FHE.select). Supply/borrow/reveal all use encrypted params.

errorCodes.name: FlashLoanUnsupportedToken
errorCodes.description: Token not supported for flash loans

smartContracts.name: StrategyVault
smartContracts.description: Encrypted vault positions tied to on-chain strategies. Users open positions with encrypted collateral within a registered strategy.

readFunctions.name: getCollateral
readFunctions.description: Get encrypted collateral for a position, ACL-granted to caller.

writeFunctions.name: openPosition
writeFunctions.description: Open a vault position with encrypted collateral. Creates positionId = keccak256(user, nonce).

writeFunctions.name: addCollateral
writeFunctions.description: Add encrypted collateral to existing position.

writeFunctions.name: closePosition
writeFunctions.description: Close or partially close a position. Decrements strategy TVL.

writeFunctions.name: withdrawPaused
writeFunctions.description: Emergency withdrawal when contract is paused.

events.name: PositionOpened
events.signature: PositionOpened(bytes32 indexed, address indexed, address indexed, uint256)

events.name: CollateralAdded
events.signature: CollateralAdded(bytes32 indexed, address indexed, address indexed)

events.name: PositionClosed
events.signature: PositionClosed(bytes32 indexed, address indexed, address indexed, bool)

events.name: PausedWithdrawn
events.signature: PausedWithdrawn(bytes32 indexed, address indexed, address indexed, uint256)

fheMarkers.note: Position collateral stored as euint128. ACL granted via SharedStrategyMeta helper. Equality verification in closePosition.

errorCodes.name: SameBlockClose
errorCodes.description: Cannot close in same block as open

errorCodes.name: NotPositionOwner
errorCodes.description: Caller is not the position owner

smartContracts.name: FheForgeComposer
smartContracts.description: Multi-step strategy orchestration. Chains Vault (collateral), LendingPool (supply/borrow), and SwapRouter (token conversion) in a single atomic transaction.

writeFunctions.name: openPosition
writeFunctions.description: Open a leveraged strategy. Chains vault→pool→swap in one atomic tx. Pre-approve Composer via ERC20 transferFrom.

writeFunctions.name: rebalance
writeFunctions.description: Rebalance a strategy: add collateral, repay, and/or borrow. Pre-approve Composer.

writeFunctions.name: sweepToken
writeFunctions.description: Owner-only. Sweep accidental token balances.

events.name: LeveragedStrategyOpened
events.signature: LeveragedStrategyOpened(address indexed, uint256 indexed, bytes32 indexed)

fheMarkers.note: Composer uses FHE handles passed through from user. Equality verification via _verifyEquality before forwarding to Vault/Pool/Router.

smartContracts.name: SwapRouter
smartContracts.description: Two swap pathways: intent-based swaps (submitSwapIntent/executeIntent) and direct Uniswap V3 (swapViaUniswapV3Single/swapViaUniswapV3MultiHop).

writeFunctions.name: submitSwapIntent
writeFunctions.description: Submit a swap intent. Tokens escrowed from user. Requires executor to fill.

writeFunctions.name: cancelIntent
writeFunctions.description: Cancel a pending swap intent and return escrowed tokens.

writeFunctions.name: executeIntent
writeFunctions.description: Executor-only. Execute a swap intent with output amount.

writeFunctions.name: swapViaUniswapV3Single
writeFunctions.description: Direct Uniswap V3 single-hop swap with slippage protection.

writeFunctions.name: swapViaUniswapV3MultiHop
writeFunctions.description: Direct Uniswap V3 multi-hop swap with encoded path.

writeFunctions.name: proposeExecutor
writeFunctions.description: Owner-only. Propose a new executor with timelock.

writeFunctions.name: acceptExecutor
writeFunctions.description: Accept pending executor role after timelock expires.

events.name: IntentSubmitted
events.signature: IntentSubmitted(bytes32 indexed, address indexed, address indexed, address, uint256)

events.name: IntentExecuted
events.signature: IntentExecuted(bytes32 indexed, address indexed, uint256 indexed)

events.name: UniswapV3SingleSwap
events.signature: UniswapV3SingleSwap(address indexed, address indexed, address indexed, uint256, uint256)

events.name: UniswapV3MultiHopSwap
events.signature: UniswapV3MultiHopSwap(address indexed, uint256 indexed, uint256 indexed)

fheMarkers.note: SwapRouter does not use FHE directly. However, amounts for swap intents may come from FHE-encrypted protocol flows.

errorCodes.name: SameToken
errorCodes.description: TokenIn and TokenOut are the same

errorCodes.name: NotCreator
errorCodes.description: Caller is not the intent creator

smartContracts.name: PriceOracle
smartContracts.description: Pyth oracle as primary price feed with admin-set fallback. Two-tier: getPriceWithFallback tries fresh Pyth price, falls back to fallbackPrices if stale/failed.

readFunctions.name: getPriceUsd
readFunctions.description: Get Pyth price in 18-dec WAD and timestamp.

readFunctions.name: getPriceWithFallback
readFunctions.description: Get price with fallback if Pyth feed is stale.

readFunctions.name: convertToUsd
readFunctions.description: Convert token amount to USD value (18-dec WAD).

readFunctions.name: convertFromUsd
readFunctions.description: Convert USD value to token amount.

writeFunctions.name: updatePriceFeeds
writeFunctions.description: Update Pyth price feeds with fresh oracle data.

events.name: SourceSet
events.signature: SourceSet(address indexed, bytes32 indexed, uint8 indexed, uint64)

events.name: CollateralFactorSet
events.signature: CollateralFactorSet(address indexed, uint16 indexed, uint16 indexed)

fheMarkers.note: PriceOracle does not use FHE. Oracle provides plaintext price data for LTV/liquidation checks.

errorCodes.name: PythUpdateFeeMismatch
errorCodes.description: ETH value doesn't match Pyth update fee

errorCodes.name: NoPriceAvailable
errorCodes.description: No price available from Pyth or fallback

smartContracts.name: StrategyRegistry
smartContracts.description: Strategy registry. Users register strategies (name, workflowHash, apyTarget, loopCount). Vault-managed encrypted TVL per strategy. Cross-chain broadcast via event.

readFunctions.name: getEncryptedTvl
readFunctions.description: Get encrypted TVL for a strategy, ACL-granted to caller.

writeFunctions.name: registerStrategy
writeFunctions.description: Register a new strategy (basic).

writeFunctions.name: registerStrategy
writeFunctions.description: Register a new strategy with APY target and loop count.

writeFunctions.name: setActive
writeFunctions.description: Activate/deactivate a strategy (creator only).

writeFunctions.name: incrementTvl
writeFunctions.description: Vault-only. Increment encrypted TVL.

writeFunctions.name: decrementTvl
writeFunctions.description: Vault-only. Decrement encrypted TVL.

writeFunctions.name: setVault
writeFunctions.description: Owner-only. Set vault address (one-time).

writeFunctions.name: proposeVault
writeFunctions.description: Owner-only. Propose new vault with timelock.

writeFunctions.name: acceptVault
writeFunctions.description: Accept pending vault role after timelock.

writeFunctions.name: broadcastStrategy
writeFunctions.description: Broadcast strategy to another domain via cross-chain message.

events.name: CrossChainMessage
events.signature: CrossChainMessage(uint256 indexed, bytes32 indexed, address indexed, bytes)

fheMarkers.note: Encrypted TVL stored per strategy as euint128. FHE permission check via FHE.isAllowed before modification.

errorCodes.name: OnlyVault
errorCodes.description: Caller is not the vault contract

errorCodes.name: OnlyCreator
errorCodes.description: Caller is not the strategy creator

errorCodes.name: FhePermissionDenied
errorCodes.description: FHE handle not allowed for this contract

errorCodes.name: StrategyAlreadyExists
errorCodes.description: Strategy already registered for this creator+name

smartContracts.name: StrategyExecutor
smartContracts.description: Pipeline executor for multi-step strategies. Executes a sequence of actions (shield, borrow, swap, repay, vault deposit/withdraw) atomically with gas checkpointing. Uses FHE.allowTransient for ephemeral permission grants during pipeline execution.

readFunctions.name: checkpoints
readFunctions.description: Get the execution checkpoint for a strategy: (actionIndex, completed).

writeFunctions.name: executePipeline
writeFunctions.description: Execute a pipeline of actions with gas checkpointing. Saves progress if gas runs low.

writeFunctions.name: resetCheckpoint
writeFunctions.description: Owner-only. Reset execution checkpoint for a strategy.

writeFunctions.name: sweepToken
writeFunctions.description: Owner-only. Sweep accidental token balances.

events.name: PipelineExecuted
events.signature: PipelineExecuted(bytes32 indexed, uint256 indexed, bool indexed)

events.name: ActionExecuted
events.signature: ActionExecuted(bytes32 indexed, uint256 indexed, bytes4 indexed)

fheMarkers.note: StrategyExecutor validates encrypted handles via _validateCiphertext(FHE.asEuint128(action.encAmount)) before any action-specific logic. Uses _verifyEquality for plaintext vs ciphertext consistency checks.

smartContracts.name: TokenRegistry
smartContracts.description: Token registry managing supported tokens, their LTV/liquidation parameters, flags (lendable, borrowable, collateral), Pyth price IDs, and supply/borrow caps. Ownable by protocol admin.

readFunctions.name: tokens
readFunctions.description: Get TokenInfo struct for a token address.

readFunctions.name: tokenList
readFunctions.description: Get token address at index in the token list array.

readFunctions.name: getTokenCount
readFunctions.description: Get the total number of registered tokens.

readFunctions.name: isTokenEnabled
readFunctions.description: Check if a token is enabled.

readFunctions.name: getCollateralTokens
readFunctions.description: Get all tokens that can be used as collateral.

writeFunctions.name: registerToken
writeFunctions.description: Owner-only. Register a new token with price ID, flags, caps, and LTV.

writeFunctions.name: updateTokenConfig
writeFunctions.description: Owner-only. Update a token configuration.

writeFunctions.name: disableToken
writeFunctions.description: Owner-only. Disable a token.

events.name: TokenRegistered
events.signature: TokenRegistered(address indexed, bytes32 indexed, uint8 indexed)

fheMarkers.note: TokenRegistry does not use FHE. It manages token metadata and configuration only.

smartContracts.name: ExecutorContract
smartContracts.description: Simple executor contract owned by protocol. Calls SwapRouter.executeIntent to fill swap intents and manages token approvals.

writeFunctions.name: executeIntent
writeFunctions.description: Owner-only. Execute a swap intent on a given router contract.

events.name: IntentExecuted
events.signature: IntentExecuted(bytes32 indexed, address indexed, uint256 indexed)

fheMarkers.note: ExecutorContract does not use FHE. It is a simple owned contract for executing swap intents.
